signature_comparison.rationale: Retail is cdecl int32_t(void) with no arguments and a 32-bit int result; the candidate is extern "C" __cdecl int QTask_CreateTask() with no arguments and the same 32-bit result.

limitations: Link presence is not behavioural parity. The linked symbol _QTask_CreateTask exists at 0x0041FB60 in candidate sha256 11f939200afd865bf7286ee2a90ac393a5887b1bb9589b0b1a324dfbbd59a581, but the candidate main does not call it and QTask_RegisterClasses still throws on its first untranscribed registrar (0x00508F80) before Flow_CreateHandler and Flow_SetState.
No genuine paired retail/candidate game-process runtime capture exists for this address; runtime_tests is absent and RUNTIME_TESTED/VERIFIED is not claimed.

runtime_contract.execution_status: executed: both sides observed at least one call of this native in the same level1 windowed scenario; the typed first-call records and the cumulative census were compared field by field and matched.
runtime_contract.reviewed_window_note: The probe snapshots the 0x50-byte window at +0x1C0 around the three reviewed offsets; these are the probe defaults and were also passed explicitly by the round-20 harness. No window geometry is read from a candidate symbol.
runtime_contract.note: required_observables is exactly the typedState subset this review authorizes for 0x004659E0. Fields named under recorded_but_not_compared are emitted by the probe and reported in the comparison evidence, but are properties of the input or of the caller, not of the contract, so they are not equality-compared: the hash is a pure input->output function and the view reset writes a fixed post-state. Input->output parity for the hash is established separately by the shared-input table (identical input strings observed on both sides with identical returns and identical expected values). Only scalar values, bit patterns, pointer classes, offsets and within-process relations are compared; no address is compared across processes. The probe emits explicit unavailable markers for any field it cannot read and never throws. reviewed_no_calls and reviewed_no_stores are static-review assertions (the reviewed bytes contain no call and no store instruction); their runtime corroboration is write_target_count=0 and input_string_unchanged_after_call=true.

limitations: One paired scenario only: retail level 1, windowed (arguments "window level1"), working directory Z:\Users\haseeb-mir\Downloads\IGI, one capture per side. Other levels, fullscreen mode, other command lines and other working directories were not captured.
This is runtime parity for the typed contract above, not VERIFIED status, and it does not claim that the whole game, its startup sequence or any other native is equivalent.
The candidate image is rebuilt by other agents while this work runs; the harness resolved the symbols, verified the candidate callsite byte and staged the exact image whose SHA-256 is recorded here.

Call sites differ and this is the material scope limit: the single observed retail call came from HumanPlayer_HandleInput_7 on a heap human, while the candidate calls the native from Scene_draw on a zeroed stack scratch buffer once per frame. The function is a fixed post-state store routine, so the contract is input-independent, but the two sides were exercised through different callers and different input objects and call-count parity is explicitly not claimed.

Only the first natural call per side has a full typed record; every later call is summarized in the cumulative census. The census shows a single distinct post-state triple on both sides, independent of the per-call pre-state.

The retail stores are the exact bits of tan(float pi/4) and tan(float pi/6) produced by x87 fptan; the comparison asserts the stored bit patterns, not a floating-point tolerance or the fptan instruction path.
No raw pointer or address is compared across processes; only offsets, bit patterns and within-process relations are compared.
does_not_establish: VERIFIED status or equivalence for any path, caller, level or configuration not observed here.

The measured candidate is the pre-link COFF object (source sha256 26f2fae179d54cc897618fb187c997e441884de1eb8ed260f30705abe3698e97, object sha256 bcd7070c3f5455d6ab5e14d68734ef8826990a5263e8d68a3a1346ab86b855f2). build-clean-win32/igi1.exe now contains this function at 0x00463080 (.text 0x20A0, real body), but it was linked before the correction, so the executable body is the pre-fix revision; relinking is outside this task.
cfg_similarity 1.0 is the retail Binary Ninja-vs-radare2 score only; the candidate comparison is source/object-level and is not reduced to a jaccard value.

The rebuilt object measures 1701 objdump instructions / 169 blocks / 268 edges / 8384-byte .text versus retail 1114 / 146 / 228 / 4181. The same measurement script reproduces the recorded pre-fix 1700 / 168 / 267, so the correction adds one instruction, one block and one edge; code size and block shape are not comparable across compilers.

The callback tables 0x00A9CAE0 and 0x00A9C4E0 are all zero in the file image and are populated at runtime. Call targets are unresolved; the comparison covers the call sites, the zero-extended category index, the (item, [item+0x48]) argument order and the cdecl cleanup, not the targets.
The token read 0x00B97B1C is aliased to the bounded g_data_b97b20 array; for out-of-contract indices the candidate substitutes 0xFFFF where retail reads past the established object.
x87 80-bit intermediates are modelled with double and libm atan/cos; last-bit differences in the sector extent can flip boundary cull decisions (QT-D2).
The candidate registers an SJLJ unwind frame that retail does not (QT-D3); this adds two calls and an exception-chain write per invocation.

Worklist: the array is retail's own 128 entries (ebp-0x408..ebp-0x8) and the proved maximum live occupancy is 121 for the shared push block up to level 15. The level-15 cap for the unguarded visibility mark path relies on the executed algorithm not faulting (a level-16 entry would read [child+0x30] through a null P[k] child); a deeper LOD node chain is not established by this function and is not covered by the proof.
P[] and worklist[0] are zero-initialised by the candidate where retail leaves them uninitialised for null LOD slots / a null root (QT-D6). The non-null live paths are unaffected.

The 0x20-byte child record stride at 0x004D2052 versus the 0x40-byte node view remains an unresolved data-layout question recorded in the source comment; the compared properties and the worklist proof do not depend on it.

TD-D1: retail copies six dwords from a block pointer before its null test (0x005130A7..0x005130E0), so a null block faults; the candidate tests null first and skips. Non-null paths are unchanged.

TD-D2/TD-D3: device and vertex-buffer globals are host mirrors; missing mirrors throw std::logic_error, and viewport width/height come from Display_HostGetWidth/Height instead of 0x00491CF0's 0x00C28B40 object.

TD-D4: x87 80-bit intermediates and FISTP/F2XM1 are modelled with long double, std::exp2, nearbyint and llrint; exp2l/llrintl were not proved to match every inherited x87/MXCSR rounding mode, so fog/ramp integers and boundary cull/clip decisions can differ in the last bits.

TD-D5/TD-D6: candidate local arrays and the 0x40-byte record tail are zero-initialised where retail reuses stack garbage; GCC uses a 0x1614-byte frame via __chkstk_ms, an ebp frame, an SJLJ unwind frame and an outlined flush/drain helper, versus retail's 0x14F0-byte probe and inline 0x005143B3..0x005144DC region.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja and radare2 both render stack-frame prototypes for four arguments because three 0x40-byte vertex records are passed by value and the 0x14-byte call record by pointer. The two external sites (0x00513EF7, 0x00514308) and the five recursion sites copy the three records, pass the pointer and clean 0xC4 bytes. The reviewed ABI is cdecl with TerrainMipMapsVertex r1/r2/r3 by value and TerrainMipMapsCall* call. The candidate declares exactly that shape; the different spelling is an ABI adaptation, not a semantic change.

limitations: The candidate is not CFG-isomorphic: the four retail screen stages are one table-driven loop, giving 260 blocks / 352 edges / 2 cyclic SCCs / 2 static self-recursion sites against retail 210 / 284 / 4 / 5.
No runtime, IGI-Probe, Frida or paired-game observation exists; RUNTIME_TESTED and VERIFIED are not claimed.

clip_screen_plane() aborts for a screen-stage count==3. That state is not proved unreachable from this function alone; retail would continue through a role assignment that assumes an inside vertex exists.
The purpose of g_a7e070 (0x00A7E070) is not established; only the increment/decrement pair is reproduced.
llrintl was not proved to match FISTP under every inherited x87/MXCSR rounding mode.
Record bytes +0x21..+0x23 are copied verbatim and can differ because the caller initialises them, not this function.
Record +0x24 intentionally dangles after return, matching retail; no read after return exists.
The noreturn abort helper registers an SJLJ unwind frame; retail does not. Only the trap path is affected.
The catalog name Terrain_BuildMipMaps_2 implies mip-chain construction, but the body has no level loop, allocation or texture access; the name is retained as the established symbol.

The linked candidate build-clean-win32/igi1.exe (sha256 35d92a3a...) contains the pre-fix transcription (receipt source b90d5eaa..., TU object 63e864d5..., symbol at 0x00460C50), not the corrected source 7e3c712a... / object caac5725.... The corrected object was not relinked or exercised.
The 13 retail globals remain undefined in the object by design; link-time definitions were not re-verified here.
No live behavioral runner exists for this TU, so the strict gate remains blocked on behavioral evidence.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports int32_t(void) and radare2 reports calltype cdecl with nargs 0; the display callback dispatcher 0x00491CA0 invokes it with no arguments and discards EAX. The GameNatives candidate spells the same ABI as int Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_3(void) and the engine implementation as std::int32_t Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_3() (C++ spelling, extern "C" symbol _Terrain_SelectTerrainLOD_3). The catalog name is retained for address binding even though the body creates the terrain vertex buffer and builds the render-chunk pool, not an LOD selection; that misnomer is documented in the source and the semantic review.

limitations: Status is STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED only. No execution of the initialiser was observed in retail or in the candidate, so the allocated block, the created vertex-buffer pointer and the seeded index contents are unobserved; RUNTIME_TESTED and VERIFIED are not claimed.

The implementation compiles to a COFF i386 object (i686-w64-mingw32-objdump -f: file format pe-i386, architecture i386) with no warnings under -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic, and a /tmp partial link of the eight terrain objects with mem_alloc.o and heap_list.o resolves every new reference. The full igi target was not relinked and no receipt or executable binds this source to build-clean-win32/igi1.exe, so BUILD_VERIFIED is not claimed.

The transcribed function is not reachable from the current candidate: retail invokes it only through the display callback list registered by 0x00516600, and neither that registrar nor the display list is transcribed. It is compiled but not wired into any startup path.

cfg_similarity 1.0 is the retail Binary Ninja-vs-radare2 score for 0x00516640 and its callee 0x004B0B00. The candidate comparison is source/object-level, not a jaccard score: GCC if-converted the [0x00BCAD74] branch (candidate native 1 block / 0 edges vs retail 3 blocks / 3 edges), eliminated dead first stores, reordered the independent descriptor stores, and specialised the noinline helper as a .constprop.0 clone using field addresses instead of one descriptor pointer. The structural review records each divergence; no block-for-block equivalence is claimed.

The 509-entry bucket seed at 0x00516621..0x0051663C belongs to the registrar 0x00516600, not to this native, and is not executed by the transcribed function. It populates 0x00A7E080..0x00A7F85B and remains untranscribed.

The callee 0x004B0B00 is a shared descriptor constructor with 32 retail callers; only the terrain call is transcribed. The candidate helper is not a general replacement, and the Mem_Alloc (0x004B0C60) failure path was not exercised in either program.
